header.subject: Chemistry
header.title: STATES OF MATTER & CHANGES OF STATE

vocab.definition: solid → liquid as particles gain energy.

misconceptions.right: Particles gain energy and move more — they don't grow.

misconceptions.wrong: Mass changes during a state change.
misconceptions.right: Mass is conserved; only arrangement/energy changes.

questions.text: Describe the arrangement of particles in a solid. [2 marks]
Name the change of state from gas to liquid. [1 mark]
Explain, using particles, what happens when a solid melts. [3 marks]
Give the state symbol for a substance dissolved in water. [1 mark]
Complete the sentence using the word bank. [2 marks]
questions.secondaryText: When a substance is heated, particles gain ______ so the forces between them become ______ enough to break.

questions.text: Suggest one limitation of the simple particle model. [1 mark]

footer.tip: Heating gives particles more energy to overcome the forces holding them together.
footer.thinkPrompt: Why does a substance stay at the same temperature while it is melting?
